description: Frontend: Feature 2 (Explainable Risk) + Feature 3 (What-If Simulator) in PatientDashboard.jsx and GuestDashboard.jsx. These two features both operate on the prediction result panel in the same two files, so they are batched together to avoid editing those large files twice. Independent of FEAT-001's CSS/theme changes but depends on FEAT-001's backend factors API.
steps:
STEP 2 — PatientDashboard.jsx: Find the result panel render section (where result is displayed with risk_score, risk_level, clinical_reasoning). After the existing risk score display block and before the remedy tabs, add the 'Why this score?' panel:
  - A toggle button: 'Why this score?' that sets showFactors(!showFactors)
  - When showFactors=true, render a div with: heading 'Key Risk Factors', disclaimer text 'These factors influenced the machine learning model estimate. They do not establish medical causation or constitute a diagnosis.', then map over result.factors (if any): for each factor render a row with factor.feature name, value, and a horizontal bar proportional to factor.importance (max width 100%, width = factor.importance * 100 + '%'). Style with inline glassmorphism: background rgba(255,255,255,0.04), border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1), rounded corners. If result.factors is empty or undefined, show 'Factor breakdown not available for this analysis.'

STEP 4 — PatientDashboard.jsx: Add the simulator panel (rendered below the result panel when showSimulator=true). Panel contains:
  - Title: 'What-If Risk Simulator'
  - Disclaimer: 'This is a model simulation, not a medical prediction or treatment recommendation. Changing a value does not guarantee a real-world health outcome.'
  - For Heart: number inputs for Systolic BP, Diastolic BP, Cholesterol, Max Heart Rate (show current value as placeholder)
  - For Diabetes: number inputs for Glucose, HbA1c, BMI
  - For Cancer: select dropdowns for Alcohol (yes/no), Toxin Exposure (yes/no), Smoking (yes/no)
  - 'Recalculate Simulation' button: calls POST /api/predictions/simulate/ with {disease_type: diseaseNameMap[selectedDisease], parameters: {...simParams, age, gender, family_history, smoking, symptoms: []}} — use api.post('/predictions/simulate/', ...). On success setSimResult(response.data).
  - Show current estimate vs simulated estimate: 'Current estimate: {result.risk_score}% | Simulated estimate: {simResult.simulated_score}% | Difference: {diff > 0 ? '+' : ''}{diff} percentage points'
  - 'Close' button to setShowSimulator(false)

STEP 5 — GuestDashboard.jsx: Apply identical changes as STEP 1–4 above. The two files are near-identical in structure. Add the same state variables, same 'Why this score?' panel, same 'What If?' simulator panel.
STEP 6 — Verify both files compile: run Vite build and confirm no JSX errors.
acceptance_criteria: After a prediction, 'Why this score?' button appears in result panel in both PatientDashboard and GuestDashboard
Clicking 'Why this score?' shows up to 5 factors with names, values, and horizontal importance bars
Disclaimer text appears below factors panel
After a prediction, 'What If?' button appears in result panel
Clicking 'What If?' opens simulator panel with editable inputs pre-filled from current submission
Simulated estimate is displayed alongside current estimate with difference in percentage points
verification: cd d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\frontend && node_modules\.bin\vite build 2>&1 (expect: built in X.Xs with no errors)
